description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Thelonite Hermit, adding {G}.
Thelonite Hermit dies, triggering Yedora, returning Thelonite Hermit from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Thelonite Hermit by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Thelonite Hermit's morph ability by paying {3}{G}{G}, turning it face up.
Thelonite Hermit triggers, creating four 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Saprolings, adding {3}.
Repeat.
